name: JV_CONTRIBUTIONS_B
description: This table contains joint venture partner contribution  definitions.

columns.name: CONTRIBUTION_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the partner contribution.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: JOINT_VENTURE_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier of the joint venture assigned to the partner contribution.

columns.name: STAKEHOLDER_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier of the stakeholder assigned to the partner contribution.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: The date when joint venture distribution records can be applied to the partner contribution.

columns.name: SEQUENCE_NUMBER
columns.description: The sequence number of the partner contribution.

columns.name: CONTRIBUTION_AMOUNT
columns.description: The contribution amount for the stakeholder in the ledger currency. This is the amount that will be assigned to joint venture distributions and drawn against.

columns.name: CONTRIBUTION_OPEN_AMOUNT
columns.description: The amount available to be drawn, transferred, or refunded for the partner contribution.

columns.name: CONTRIBUTION_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: The status code of the partner contribution. It is based on ORA_JV_CONTRIBUTION_STATUS. Statuses include: In Progress, Invoiced, Available to Draw, Closed, On Hold, or Error.

columns.name: CLOSE_REASON_CODE
columns.description: The reason code identifying why the partner contribution was closed. It is based on ORA_JV_PC_CLOSE_REASON_CODE.

columns.name: CLOSE_DATE
columns.description: The date the partner contribution was closed.

columns.name: CLOSE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: The type code used to identify how the partner contribution was closed. It is based on ORA_JV_PC_CLOSE_TYPE. Close types include: Journal Entry or AP Invoice.

columns.name: REFUND_AMOUNT
columns.description: The amount to be refunded to the partner when the partner contribution is closed.

columns.name: AGREEMENT_DEFAULT_CHARGE
columns.description: The amount charged to the partner when closing the partner contribution.

columns.name: TRANSFER_TO_CONTRIBUTION_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier of the partner contribution that the open amount was transferred to when closing this partner contribution.

columns.name: OWNERSHIP_PERCENTAGE_ID
columns.description: Identifier for the ownership definition that was used to create the partner contribution.

columns.name: PREFERRED_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: The currency code that will be used to create the partner contribution receivables invoice for the stakeholder.

columns.name: FOREIGN_CONTRIBUTION_AMOUNT
columns.description: The contribution amount for the stakeholder in the preferred currency. This amount is populated only when the preferred currency is different from the primary ledger currency of the joint venture.

columns.name: GROSS_CONTRIBUTION_AMOUNT
columns.description: The gross partner contribution amount that was split among the stakeholders defined in the ownership definition. This amount is in the preferred currency of the contribution. If the preferred currency is not defined, this amount will be in the currency of the primary ledger associated with the joint venture.

columns.name: PARTNER_ACCOUNT_CCID
columns.description: The code combination identifier for the partner account used when invoicing the stakeholder for the partner contribution.

columns.name: AUTOMATIC_CONTRIBUTION_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the partner contribution was created automatically or manually. A value of "Y" indicates that the partner contribution was created automatically by the system. A value of "N" indicates that the partner contribution was manually created.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: CONTRIBUTION_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the partner contribution request.

columns.name: ACCOUNT_SET_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the account set used by the partner contribution to select distributions to draw against the partner contribution.

columns.name: PROJECT_SET_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the project set used by the partner contribution to select distributions to draw against the partner contribution.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
